title: Japan’s Kishida On Growth Strategy and Yen Intervention

title: Glencore Eyes Australia Listing to Tap $3.1 Trillion Pension Pot
summary: Glencore Plc will launch a secondary listing in Australia as soon as October as the mining giant seeks to tap new investment in the nation’s fast-growing A$4.4 trillion ($3.1 trillion) pension system.

title: Prabowo’s Radical Commodity Export Plan Faces Dueling Visions
summary: More than two months after President Prabowo Subianto unveiled plans to take control of Indonesia’s top commodity exports, the agency charged with carrying out the proposal is caught between competing visions of its role in the economy’s most vital export industry.

title: ‘Sell America’ Debate Re-Emerges as US Policies Sow Doubts
summary: Global bond and currency investors are debating if it’s time to dust off last year’s ‘Sell America’ trade after a flurry of economic-policy decisions out of Washington over the past two weeks.

title: Hedge Funds Take Big Hit in July After Bruising AI Selloff
summary: A spate of well-known hedge funds reported steep losses in July as AI shares tumbled, most notably forcing the highly leveraged Situational Awareness to sell most of its stock portfolio at a deep discount to Ken Griffin’s Citadel.

title: Japan’s Kishida Sees Growth as Game Changer for Yen
summary: Joint US-Japan intervention has helped the yen for now, but isn’t a game-changer for the currency or the economy, Japan’s former Prime Minister Fumio Kishida said in a Bloomberg TV interview in Tokyo. He touted a ¥370 trillion ($2.3 trillion) growth strategy as the long-term vision that will transform Japan’s fortunes. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Avocados at Risk as US Halts Government Work in Michoacan
summary: The US suspended government activities in the Mexican state of Michoacan, affecting imports of avocados from the largest producing region in the country to the US.

title: Liechtenstein’s LGT Aims to Expand its Private Banking in Japan
summary: LGT, a private bank owned by the Princely House of Liechtenstein, is looking to expand in Japan, betting that it can capture a share of the rising wealth in a market that has historically proved difficult for foreign private banks.

title: China’s Cheap AI Is Shifting Investors’ Focus to Internet Stocks
summary: China’s rapid progress in low-cost artificial intelligence is strengthening the investment case for the country’s internet giants after years in the shadow of chipmakers, market participants say.

title: DBS Profit Beats Estimates as Singapore Lender Raises Guidance
summary: DBS Group Holdings Ltd. reported second-quarter profit that beat expectations, powered by a surge in wealth-led fee income, and raised its 2026 guidance.

title: Zillow’s Revenue Jumps as Rentals Offer ‘Bright Spot’
summary: Zillow Group Inc. said Wednesday that second-quarter revenue jumped 18% from a year earlier to $772 million, as the online real estate company sees rental agreements growing more quickly than home purchases on its website and app.

title: MercadoLibre Drops as E-Commerce Giant Signals More Spending
summary: MercadoLibre Inc. shares slid in late trading as analysts worried about the e-commerce giant’s spending plans despite it reporting sales and profits that beat consensus estimates in the second quarter.

title: Tech Trade May See Bigger Retail Influence After July Rout, JPMorgan Says
summary: The technology trade may be poised to become even more dependent on retail investors and more volatile after a rough July, according to an assessment of preliminary data on technology, media and telecommunications equity sector hedge funds from JPMorgan Chase & Co.

title: S&P 500 Edges Lower After $3.7 Trillion Advance: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street’s blistering run took a breather, with traders digesting the recent stock gains and monitoring any hints of progress toward a deal to revive the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Fed's Cook 'Prepared to Act' on Rates If Inflation Doesn't Slow
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook cautions that the longer inflation remains above the central bank’s goal, the tougher the job will be to rein it in during remarks at an event in Alaska.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: MNTN CEO on Disney’s Ad Business, Streaming Wars Outlook
summary: MNTN CEO Mark Douglas discussed the current state of the connected TV and streaming advertising landscape following a strong earnings report from his company, which showed a 21% year-over-year revenue increase. The conversation highlighted recent earnings from major media companies, including Disney, which reported a 64% profit growth in its streaming business and 14% revenue growth, though its overall ad sales grew only 3%. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Phillips 66 Expects Soaring Fuel Margins to Last Into 2027
